jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied AI Engineer based in Switzerland.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing and building the next generation of intelligent, agentic systems.
You will develop the core infrastructure that enables AI agents to manage context, use tools, coordinate tasks, and continuously improve their performance.
Working at the intersection of advanced AI research and practical software engineering, you will transform complex operational workflows into reliable, scalable production solutions.
You will establish robust evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks to ensure AI-powered systems deliver predictable and measurable results.
You will also explore innovative ways to integrate coding agents and specialized subagents into software development processes.
Collaborating closely with product and operational teams, you will identify high-impact automation opportunities and translate them into effective technical solutions.
As an early core member of the engineering team, you will have significant influence over architectural decisions, technical standards, and the long-term AI strategy.


Accountabilities

In this role, you will design and implement the technical foundations of agentic systems while driving the adoption of AI-powered engineering workflows. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design and build essential components of agentic systems, including memory, context management, tool-calling capabilities, orchestration mechanisms, and feedback loops.

  • Develop reusable AI infrastructure that enables new workflows to be introduced quickly, consistently, and with predictable reliability.

  • Build comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, identify failure points, and understand the factors behind successful outcomes.

  • Integrate testing, tracing, debugging, and evaluation into the software engineering lifecycle as fundamental practices.

  • Develop systems and validation processes that allow agentic workflows to be thoroughly assessed before production deployment.

  • Advance the use of large language models (LLMs) in software development by creating sophisticated AI-assisted engineering workflows.

  • Build workflows where coding agents and specialized subagents can explore code repositories, implement changes, review architecture, validate conventions, run evaluations, and iterate with minimal human intervention.

  • Actively use agentic engineering tools and workflows in daily development activities.

  • Design architectures that enable specialized AI agents, tools, deterministic software, and human expertise to work together effectively.

  • Determine when to use LLMs, traditional software solutions, human intervention, or coordinated multi-agent approaches to achieve the best outcomes.

  • Collaborate with operational and product teams to understand existing processes, identify high-value automation opportunities, and transform them into reliable production systems.

  • Establish scalable architectural patterns and engineering standards for agentic systems as the organization grows.

  • Take ownership of technical decisions and contribute to the overall direction of the AI engineering function.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with hands-on experience building production-ready AI systems and the autonomy to solve complex technical challenges in a rapidly evolving environment. The following qualifications and skills are expected:

    • Strong software engineering background, with proven experience independently delivering complex systems from initial concept through production deployment.

    • Practical experience building and deploying AI or agentic systems that have operated in production environments.

    • Demonstrated understanding of real-world AI engineering challenges, including reliability, latency, context management, failure modes, evaluation, and observability.

    • Strong knowledge of agent architectures, tool use, structured outputs, context management, orchestration, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops.

    • Advanced practical experience with modern LLMs and the ability to build reliable workflows around probabilistic AI systems.

    • Hands-on experience using coding agents and agentic development workflows as part of everyday software engineering.

    • Ability to break down complex engineering tasks across multiple agents or specialized subagents and implement mechanisms for validating and improving their outputs.

    • Strong architectural judgment and the ability to select the right combination of AI models, deterministic software, and human intervention for different challenges.

    • Experience with TypeScript and Node.js, or strong experience developing AI systems in Python combined with the willingness and ability to work in a TypeScript-first environment.

    • High level of autonomy, ownership, and confidence making technical decisions in ambiguous situations.

    • Strong product mindset and the ability to connect engineering decisions with operational efficiency and business outcomes.

    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English.

    • Startup mentality, including resilience, adaptability, initiative, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

      • Benefits

      • Remote Work: Opportunity to work remotely within Europe or the United Kingdom.

      • Early-Team Influence: Join as an early core engineering team member with significant ownership over technical direction and architectural decisions.

As an AI Research Engineer specializing in Agentic Reinforcement Learning, you will drive research and innovation in next-generation intelligent systems.
You will develop advanced reinforcement learning techniques that improve decision-making, adaptive behavior, and performance across multimodal AI architectures.
Working with text, images, audio, and other data modalities, you will help build models capable of solving complex, real-world challenges.
Your work will involve designing scalable training infrastructure, optimizing reward mechanisms, and improving the reliability of autonomous AI agents.

Notre plateforme de jeu repose sur des microservices stateless : chaque traitement est une fonction pure appliquée à un message et à un état. Sur le papier, c'est le rêve pour débugger. En pratique, l'outillage n'existe pas, et CloudWatch devient vite chronophage dès qu'il faut analyser les interactions entre services.

  • Générateur de tests local : isoler une séquence, reconstruire l'arbre d'états, et en sortir des tests de non-régression automatisés
  • Replayer : une API et un back-office minimaliste pour visualiser graphiquement les états et les interactions inter-services
    • Les points d'attention : la volumétrie, la fidélité de la reconstruction chronologique, la corrélation d'événements en environnement distribué, et l'industrialisation de l'outil (CI/CD, tests, documentation).

Hi, wir sind Doonails! 💅🏼
Ein schnell wachsendes Beauty-Startup, das die Manikürewelt revolutioniert. Mit innovativen Produkten, einer starken Community und Präsenz im eigenen Online-Shop sowie bei führenden Retail-Partnern bringen wir Studio-Qualität direkt nach Hause: einfach, schnell und stilvoll. Unsere Projekte und Brand-Kampagnen wachsen rasant, und dafür brauchen wir vor allem eines: mehr Execution Power.

Und genau hier kommst DU ins Spiel.
 
Als Senior Brand Activation Manager (m/w/d) übernimmst du die Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Community-Brand-Aktivierungen und Offline-Kampagnen. Du bringst Struktur in komplexe Setups, steuerst mehrere Projekte parallel und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen echte, messbare Brand-Momente werden. Die Rolle ist hands-on und operativ stark und gleichzeitig strategisch entscheidend dafür, wie Doonails als Marke wahrgenommen wird.

Deine Rolle & dein Impact ⚡️
Du bringst Struktur, Klarheit und Energie in unsere Brand-Projekte und ermöglichst eine starke Zusammenarbeit im Team. Mit hochwertigen Offline-Aktivierungen machst du Doonails erlebbar und steigerst unsere Brand Awareness spürbar. Gleichzeitig baust du Brand Activation als skalierbaren Bereich mit klarer Ownership weiter aus – für Qualität, Konsistenz und Tempo in allem, was wir gemeinsam umsetzen.

Deine zentralen Aufgaben 👩‍💻👨‍💻

Brand Activation & Campaign Management

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Planung von Events, Pop-ups, Tours, Launches und Offline-Kampagnen.

    • End-to-End-Projektmanagement

  • Von der ersten Timeline über die Budgetüberwachung bis hin zum finalen Qualitätscheck behältst du alle Fäden sicher in der Hand.

    • Koordination externer Partner & Dienstleister

  • Das lückenlose Briefing und die Verhandlung externer Partner, darunter Locations, Messebauer, Produktionsteams, Deko und Technik, fallen voll in deinen Verantwortungsbereich.

    • Markenauftritt

  • In engem Schulterschluss mit dem Brand Design Team stellst du sicher, dass Doonails an jedem physischen Touchpoint konsistent, hochwertig und stilvoll erlebbar wird.

    • Steigerung der Brand Awareness

  • Die gezielte Steigerung unserer Brand Awareness treibst du aktiv voran, machst Erfolge anhand klarer KPIs messbar und leitest wertvolle Reportings ab.

    • Stakeholder Management & Kommunikation

  • Sowohl intern über verschiedene Departments hinweg als auch extern gegenüber Kooperationspartnern fungierst du als souveräne, lösungsorientierte Drehscheibe.


    • Das bringst du mit 🤝

  • Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Beauty, Fashion oder Lifestyle und nachweisbare Erfahrung in Brand Activation & Event Management

  • Projektmanagement: Exzellente Projektmanagement-Skills im Multi-Projekt-Setup

  • Partner- & Netzwerkkompetenz: Erfahrung im Vendor-, Agentur- und Dienstleister-Management

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Starkes Stakeholder Management

  • Reisebereitschaft: für den Aufbau, die Begleitung und das Monitoring unserer Events, Pop-ups und Kampagnen direkt am Geschehen, damit jeder Markenmoment perfekt sitzt.
  • Kommunikation: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
    •  
     

     


    Was wir dir bieten 💖

  • 💸 Faire Bezahlung, angepasst an deine Qualifikation & Erfahrung

  • 🤝 Ein echtes Ownership-Rollenprofil mit viel Vertrauen & Gestaltungsspielraum

  • 🇪🇺 100 % Remote in Deutschland: arbeite flexibel von überall

  • 📈 Wachstumspotenzial: übernimm Verantwortung & bring deine Ideen direkt ein

  • 📚 1.300 € Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr für deine persönliche Entwicklung

  • 🧘 Nilo Health, denn mentale Gesundheit ist uns wichtig und dein Zugang ist inklusive

jobs.description:

What you bring

  • Deep knowledge of government procurement, including tenders and RFPs
  • A strong professional network you can put to work from day one
  • Experience managing large, strategic accounts in multi-stakeholder environments

jobs.title: Account Director - Financiers
jobs.description:
Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
 
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?
 
 

Purpose of the role

The successful candidate will own Keyloop's relationships with financiers, both captive (OEM-owned) and independent, while maximising client adoption of the Keyloop Retention Hub through a customer retention lens and growing the use of Keyloop's AI-based capabilities within the Retention space. The role is UK-based with a global account book and regular international travel, reporting directly into the Financiers & Fleet Director. The candidate will understand the commercial dynamics of automotive finance and be equally comfortable operating at operational and senior commercial/strategic levels within each financier.


Key Headlines
  • First point of contact for existing and new financier accounts, spanning captive and independent financiers.
  • Own the senior relationship with financiers and grow the Keyloop Retention Hub agenda across their organisations and, where relevant, their dealer networks.
  • Drive adoption of the Keyloop Retention Hub with a specific focus on customer retention outcomes.
  • Lead cross-sell of AI-based capabilities within the Retention space (such as AI video and lead nurture), and identify new client opportunities across the wider Keyloop portfolio.
  • UK-based role with regular international travel; account book is global.
  • Monthly face-to-face team meetings in the UK.

    • Key Duties & Responsibilities
  • Deliver excellent account management across captive and independent financier stakeholders.
  • Maintain weekly dialogue with clients on Keyloop Retention Hub adoption and customer retention outcomes.
  • Build and maintain multi-level relationships within financier organisations (commercial, risk, retention/customer, operations and IT), from operational teams through to senior leadership.
  • Develop and apply a thorough understanding of financier commercial models, the customer ownership lifecycle (including PCP/PCH and trade cycle management) and retention dynamics, and how these intersect with dealer network operations.
  • Support contract renewals and commercial negotiations alongside Legal and the Enterprise Team, including liaison with financier procurement and legal teams.
  • Position the Keyloop Retention Hub and its AI-based capabilities as drivers of customer retention and commercial value in client conversations.
  • Produce Quarterly Review Packs covering retention outcomes, adoption of the Retention Hub and AI-based capabilities, and system development delivered.
  • Collaborate with key financier contacts to understand their short, medium and long-term retention strategies, ensuring Keyloop is the partner of choice.
  • Keep product/sales presentation material and POS assets current and available on shared portals.
  • Feed back market intelligence on competitor retention and AI-based offerings to sharpen internal positioning.

    • Skillset and Experience required
  • Experience within the automotive sector, ideally within automotive finance (captive or independent financier).
  • Direct experience working with captive or independent financiers — understanding of their commercial models, customer lifecycle and retention priorities, and relationships with dealer networks. Financier-side experience is strongly favourable.
  • Thorough understanding of the automotive finance customer lifecycle, including origination, contract management, end-of-contract customer journey, and retention and trade cycle management.
  • Experience selling SaaS/cloud-based solutions.
  • Proven track record in account management, ideally managing senior corporate stakeholders within financiers.
  • User or provider experience with customer retention solutions, ideally within automotive finance.
  • Customer- and outcomes-focused, with the maturity and diplomacy to manage engagement across financier stakeholder levels — from operational through to senior commercial/strategic.
  • Able to implement a professional, structured sales approach using MEDDPIC (Keyloop's preferred sales methodology) — covering Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria, Decision Process, Paper Process, Identify Pain and Champion — alongside use of Salesforce.
  • Self-driven, ambitious, resilient, highly motivated, competitive, resourceful, excellent communication skills, especially around listening, questioning – politely assertive.
  • Fluency in English is required, and proficiency in another European language — such as French, Spanish, Italian, or German — is preferred.
  • Highly organised within a process-oriented environment. Computer literate and familiarity with SF.com an advantage.
  • Fluency with AI tools such as Claude and Copilot is a plus but not mandatory.
    • Why join us?
    We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
     
    An inclusive environment to thrive
    We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity.  We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.
     
    Be rewarded for your efforts
    We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
     
    Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.
     
    We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce.  We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.
     
    "At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity."

jobs.title: Software/Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you. 

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.


To help fuel that growth, we need a Data Engineer to join our Engineering team. 
 
This team is the beating heart of Prima. 
 
You’ll be joining over 300 engineers across software development, infrastructure, operations and security. Fueled by curiosity, experimentation and collaboration, you’ll help deliver scalable, impactful solutions that shape the future of insurance.
 
Excited to make an impact? Here are the details
 
You’ll be joining our pricing and underwriting domain to bridge the gap between machine learning/data science and engineering. You will help build, publish, and maintain our complex data products and pipelines, key elements that have a significant impact on the company’s growth.

What you’ll do
  • Shaping the architecture of data products designed for data analytics and data science specifically focusing on use cases like forecasting, feature engineering, customer behaviour, and integration of new data sources.
  • Leading the way in data transformation by setting up best practices in areas like Data modelling, performance optimisation, Data Governance etc, ensuring that the data used within Prima is consistent, available and reliable.
  • Build reusable technology that enables teams to ingest, store, transform, and serve their own data products.
  • Engaging with data scientists and machine learning engineers to explore the product landscape and refine data requirements for enhanced data infrastructure.
  • Embrace continuous learning and experimentation to stay updated on emerging technologies, from testing open source tools to engaging in community-building activities like Meetups. Your passion for staying at the forefront of the field will drive your journey.
    •  

    What we’re looking for
  • Expert in batch, distributed data processing and near real-time streaming data pipelines with technologies like Kafka, Flink, Spark etc. Experience in Databricks is a plus.
  • Experience in Data Lake / Big Data Analytics platform implementation with cloud based solution; AWS preferred.
  • Proficient in Python programming and software engineering best practices.
  • Expertise with RDBMS, Data Warehousing, Data Modelling with relational SQL (Redshift, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases.
  • Proficiency in DevOps, CI/CD pipeline management, and expertise in infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployment industry-best practices.
    •  

    Nice-to-Have
  • Hands-on experience in Data Quality and Data Governance techniques.
  • Knowledge on MLOps and Feature engineering.
  • Exposure to common data analysis and ML technologies such as on scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, XGBoost, LightGBM.
  • Exposure to tools like Apache Oozie, Apache Airflow.
    •  
    Why you’ll love it here:
     
    We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.
     
    🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year.

    🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

    🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

    Think you’re a match? Apply now.

     

    At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

LA MAISON
 
Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai.

VOS MISSIONS

·       Gérer la mise en page des différents documents pour la communication interne.
 
 
VOTRE PROFIL
 
·   Issue d’une formation type École Nationales Supérieure d’Architecture (Licence 3 à master ) École de Design d’Espace ou équivalent.

En production :

SAV :

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role

Linkup is the web search engine built for AI. Our infrastructure crawls, indexes and serves the live web to AI agents, and it’s scaling fast.

We’re looking for a top‑tier Machine Learning Engineer to join Linkup and work hand‑in‑hand with our CTO, Denis Charrier, and the rest of the tech team.

Your core responsibilities will be to:
Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

  • Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

  • Bring new ranking signals into the engine, beyond pure relevance

  • Build the evaluation framework that tells us what really improves search quality

  • Optimize model serving for latency and GPU cost

  • Turn customer and benchmark feedback into ranking improvements, with clear before/after numbers

     
 

Requirements

You’re a great match if you:

  • Are excited to help build Google for AI agents- and believe in Linkup’s mission

  • Have strong hands-on experience in information retrieval, ranking or search in production.

  • Build rigorous evals and check the data behind every number

  • Care about latency, cost and reliability as much as model quality

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment

 

Example Projects

  • Ship a new ranking model to production and prove the gain on our eval sets

  • Push our models to the next level: better answers, lower latency, lower cost per query

  • Build and maintain the evaluations framework that measures every change to our search engine

 

Our Stack

Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, Ray, Spark / Databricks, Vespa, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform

Details

The ideal candidate will play a central role in our engineering team, partnering closely with the founders. The models you ship will decide what thousands of AI products read every day.

We offer a flexible remote‑work policy- see the details here.

Join us and leverage your expertise to push the boundaries of AI!

 

About Linkup

 

Our Vision

We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web. These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information.

AI agents need web search. To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off.

Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs. Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space.

Web 2.0 is sunsetting. The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home.

Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up. We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone.

Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup.

 

Our Mission

Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve.

Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs.

 

Our Culture

Our culture is built on the following values:

  • Mission. We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents.

  • Speed. We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well.

  • Ownership. We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion.

  • Teamwork. Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset.

  • Humility. We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences.

We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture.

 

Our Team

We are a small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents.

A bit more about our 3 co-founders:

  • Philippe Mizrahi- Led the development of Lyft’s Autonomous Vehicles marketplace. Previously launched Amundsen, an open source search engine.

  • Denis Charrier- Founding Engineer at Niland, an audio search company (acquired by Spotify), then Staff Engineer at Spotify. 15y of software development experience.

  • Boris Toledano- Led robotics at Carrefour, after 3y at McKinsey & Co working on public affairs and digital transformation.

About the Role
We're hiring Linkup's first SDR/BDR, a hybrid pipeline-generation role covering both sides of the funnel: qualifying inbound signups and running structured outbound into our priority segments (AI-native companies, GTM tooling providers, enterprise and regulated accounts).
You'll work closely with our VP Sales, picking accounts, drafting outbound, and partnering with AEs to turn interest into qualified pipeline. High ownership, fast feedback loop.

What You'll Do

  • Research target accounts and draft personalized multi-channel outreach (email, LinkedIn, phone) for founder-led and AE-assisted outbound

  • Monitor and pre-qualify inbound signups against our ICP (AI-native, GTM tooling, enterprise), then route to the right AE

  • Support first-touch qualification alongside AEs, learning our lead framework (ICP fit, pain, volume, timing, right entry point) as you go

  • Keep every touch logged in Attio

  • Help tune outbound messaging and channels as we scale campaigns across segments


Why This Role Matters
This is the first dedicated pipeline-generation hire at Linkup. Get it right and it compounds into every AE's quota.

You're a Great Fit If You

  • Have 0 to 2 years in SDR/BDR, or a first job out of a fast-paced, competitive environment (sales, consulting, we care about drive more than tenure)

  • Are comfortable with high-volume outbound and don't wait to be told what to do

  • Write clean, direct, non-generic outreach, no template-speak

  • Are curious about AI/agents and can hold a real conversation with a technical buyer, even without an engineering background

  • Want ownership fast, this role works closely with sales leadership, not layers of management

Our Stack
Attio (CRM), LemList (outbound), Slack, Notion, Apollo/Sales Navigator (prospecting), Snitcher (visitor ID), RB2B

About Linkup
Our Vision

We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web. These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information.

AI agents need web search. To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off.

Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs. Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space.

Web 2.0 is sunsetting. The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home.

Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up. We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone.

Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup.

 

Our Mission

Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve.

Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs.

 

Our Culture

Our culture is built on the following values:

  • Mission. We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents.

  • Speed. We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well.

  • Ownership. We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion.

  • Teamwork. Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset.

  • Humility. We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences.

We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture.

 

Our Team

We are small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents.

A bit more about our 3 co-founders:

  • Philippe Mizrahi- Led the development of Lyft’s Autonomous Vehicles marketplace. Previously launched Amundsen, an open source search engine.

  • Denis Charrier- Founding Engineer at Niland, an audio search company (acquired by Spotify), then Staff Engineer at Spotify. 15y of software development experience.

  • Boris Toledano- Led robotics at Carrefour, after 3y at McKinsey & Co working on public affairs and digital transformation.

Slingshot AI is the team behind Ash, the first AI designed for mental health. Our mission is to make support more accessible and help people change their lives in the ways they want.

We're a well-funded Series A company, having raised $93M from Andreessen Horowitz, Radical Ventures, Forerunner Ventures, plus top-tier tech investors involved in ElevenLabs, Captions, Shopify, Plaid, Notion, Canva, Twitch, Airtable, and many others.

Slingshot AI is the team behind Ash, the first AI designed for mental health. Our mission is to make support more accessible and help people change their lives in the ways they want.

We’re building a world-class team by empowering individuals with the autonomy, flexibility, and support they need to do their best work. We dream big, iterate fast, and care deeply. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

We're a well-funded Series A company, having raised $93M from Andreessen Horowitz, Radical Ventures, Forerunner Ventures, plus top-tier tech investors involved in ElevenLabs, Captions, Shopify, Plaid, Notion, Canva, Twitch, Airtable, and many others.

The role

As a Member of Technical Staff focused on Machine Learning, you will ship models, training infrastructure, harnesses and evals end-to-end: designing, building, and launching the tech that makes Ash differentiated as a specialized model for mental health, to change a billion minds and lives.

As a core member of a small but highly skilled team, we expect you to act as an owner and to care passionately about delivering value to our users and ultimately to make people's lives better. We are looking for builders who care deeply about the quality of their work and want to ship things that make a real difference in people's lives. We care more about how you think and build than your specific background. If you're a great engineer who's curious about ML, we'd love to hear from you.

We work on a model-agnostic post-training engine running on our own cluster of leased GPUs managed by SkyPilot, trained by an auto-research loop, and evaluated with our home-grown eval index aimed specifically at mental health. We’re constantly improving, and focus on building feedback loops over features, and constantly learning from our production performance, our psych research team, and scalable data sources. Our product tech stack uses Dart/Flutter for the app, Kotlin for core backend services, and Next.js/TypeScript for internal tooling, as well as Rust for low level media streaming. We use gRPC and GCP (Kubernetes, Cloud Run) as our primary cloud provider. You're not required to be an expert in all of these tools, but we would like you to come with a learning mindset and to not be afraid of getting your hands dirty with whatever tool the job might require.

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, owning systems other people rely on.

If you're obsessed with AI, eager to make an impact on the world, and thrive in dynamic, high-intensity environments, we invite you to apply for a position on our team.

🌍 Join the team powering the future of vision AI
Hello, hola, 你好, こんにちは, नमस्ते, hallo, bonjour! Thanks for stopping by — we know your time is valuable, so here's what makes Ultralytics special.

⚡ Who we are
At Ultralytics, we're on a mission to simplify AI for everyone. As the linkcreators of the world's leading Ultralytics YOLO models, we empower millions of developers, researchers, and companies worldwide to build state-of-the-art computer vision applications.

Following our $30M Series A round, we're expanding rapidly across our global hubs. This is an opportunity to join a fast-scaling, high-performance team that's redefining the future of vision AI — where ambition meets impact, and ideas become reality.

We move fast. We build boldly. We execute with purpose. And we do it together.

💼 About the role
As a Solutions Engineer, you'll turn complex computer vision problems into production systems built on YOLO. You'll lead technical discovery, design architectures, build benchmarks and proof-of-concepts, and guide customers from their first conversation to deployed models.

You'll work across Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering while partnering directly with customers in manufacturing, retail, security, robotics, and beyond. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who enjoys writing Python, training and optimizing models, deploying across cloud and edge, and owning outcomes throughout the customer lifecycle.

If you thrive on ambiguous problems, direct customer contact, and turning technical possibilities into measurable results, you'll fit right in.

🚀 What you'll do
Technical discovery and solution design

  • Own technical discovery, translate customer needs into architectures, and define measurable success criteria.

Prototyping and deployment

Customer engagement and enablement

Ecosystem contribution

  • Share feedback with Product and Engineering to improve the YOLO ecosystem.

  • Engage developers through the Ultralytics community and GitHub organization.


📈 What success looks like

  • 9 months: Converting technical evaluations into wins or saves, shipping reusable assets, and providing actionable feedback to the wider organization.

  • 12 months: Becoming the technical partner AEs and CSMs want on their biggest accounts, with POCs that convert and referenceable customer deployments.

Core requirements

  • Strong Python and practical experience with YOLO, OpenCV, PyTorch, and computer vision.

  • Experience training, optimizing, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models.

  • Comfortable with Docker, Git, REST APIs, Linux, cloud platforms, and edge workflows.

  • Experience deploying across Linux, macOS, and Windows environments.

  • Proven ability to deliver technical demos, workshops, architecture reviews, and POCs.

  • Strong communication skills with both technical and executive audiences.

  • Independent ownership, urgency, resilience, and results in a high-performance startup environment.

  • Passion for AI, open source, and helping customers achieve real outcomes.

At Ultralytics, we set bold goals and execute with speed, precision, and teamwork. We're driven by hard work, ambition, and resilience — building fast, learning constantly, and delivering measurable impact.

jobs.description:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the team, culture and processes that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when a strong product turns into a real business: how do we build the strategy, the partner and customer pipeline, and the operating rhythm that let us scale as fast as the technology allows?

The Role

As a Working Student or thesis student in Strategy Operations & Business Development, you will work directly with our Business Development lead and on the questions that decide how TACTILIA grows: which markets we go after, how we price and cost what we build, who our first partners and customers are, and how we prove our progress to the board.

Some days you're sizing a market or building a competitor teardown. Other days you're pulling together the numbers for a board update or helping shape a pricing model. Both matter equally here.

What You Will Do

– Support business strategy and market sizing. Help translate our target markets and product priorities into clear numbers – market size, growth, and where the real opportunity sits.

– Track the competitive landscape. Keep tabs on competitors, adjacent players, and relevant funding and product news, and turn it into insights the leadership team can actually use.

– Help build our partner and customer pipeline. Research and qualify potential integrators, partners, and anchor customers, and prepare the materials that support outreach and first conversations.

– Get our office and internal structures off the ground. Help plan and implement our office set-up and the practical structures a growing team needs on the ground – this is a hands-on part of the role, not just an analytical one.

– Help build our internal reporting and steering tools. Contribute to the dashboards and processes that give the leadership team a real-time view of the business.

What You Bring

– Currently studying business administration, industrial engineering, economics, or a related field (Bachelor's or Master's)

– A structured, analytical way of working and genuine comfort with numbers and data

– Real interest in robotics, deep tech, or Physical AI

– Confident with Excel and PowerPoint, and quick to pick up new tools

– Fluent English; German is a plus

– Available for at least four to six months, whether as a working student or for a thesis project

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability, and robustness they need to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape. The team is being built. And the standards for robotic hands and their skills are still wide open.

That means your decisions will have a lasting impact – not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

About Zipline

Zipline is the world's largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. 

Our customers include the world's largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Alwin
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer in our Amsterdam office to build Alwin, our Agentic Automation Platform for audit and finance, and the systems around it. Alwin agents run multi-step audit procedures over client evidence and return finished workpapers with every number traced back to source. Humans plan, review and sign off.

This is a hands-on role: most of your time will be spent writing code, building the hardest parts of the runtime, prototyping new capabilities and getting them into production. You lead by example: engineers follow your direction because they see it work in your code. Your impact will also come through the engineers and teams you work with.

Your mission is to build the best agentic runtime for audit: one that completes audit tasks faster, more accurately, more reliably and at lower cost, while scaling to meet the needs of our largest customers.

You will identify the problems that most constrain that mission, align teams around a technical direction and drive solutions through to measurable results, while building the foundations other engineers use and raising the quality of Alwin’s agents in production.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

What You Will Do:

Results You Will Drive

  • Better audit outcomes: improve how accurately and reliably agents complete real audit tasks, with traceable results and human oversight.

  • A faster, more efficient runtime: reduce execution time and cost while scaling to more complex workloads and larger customers.

  • More capable teams: build foundations and feedback loops that multiple teams use to ship and improve agents faster.

Build & Ship

  • Write production code every week on the most complex and critical parts of Alwin

  • Build proofs of concept for new agent capabilities, and take the ones that work all the way to production

  • Champion experimentation and R&D: try emerging models and techniques, solve hard problems creatively, and turn promising ideas into reliable features

  • Build shared capabilities that multiple teams adopt, and remain accountable for whether they make those teams faster and their products more reliable

  • Contribute directly to the agent harness at the core of Alwin: the orchestration, tools, context and evaluation loops every agent runs on

  • Anticipate where the platform needs to be in 12 to 18 months, and make design decisions now that minimize the cost of future change

Agents in Production

  • Build agents that are reliable in a regulated domain: grounding, evaluation before release, human-in-the-loop, traceability of every action

  • Improve how teams build Alwin by establishing tooling and feedback loops that help them detect agent failures, prioritize improvements, prevent regressions and ship production-ready agents faster

  • Jump into the hardest incidents across teams, resolve immediate problems and turn what you learn into lasting, systemic fixes

  • Make the trade-offs between model cost, latency and accuracy explicit, and measure them in production

Lead by Example

  • Own ambiguous, high-impact technical problems across teams: define the problem, align on the trade-offs and prove the solution in code

jobs.title: Bookkeeper (Boekhouder)
jobs.description:
Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour.

We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from diverse backgrounds, including consumer tech, finance and media, and companies like Dyson, Shopify, Meta and Tesla. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you'll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural, alongside other renowned investors.

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with a fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house, hardware and software. Our work involves building robots in our workshop and houses on real construction sites, so we're onsite five days a week.

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company. You might enjoy our YouTube Channel, Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage, or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like.

About the role

We're looking for a Bookkeeper to bring our day-to-day bookkeeping and month-end close in-house. You'll be our first dedicated bookkeeper, taking over from our external accounting firm and running the books for our growing group: five Dutch BVs today, plus our entities abroad.

Our transaction volume has roughly doubled this year, and 2027 is the first financial year our accounts will be audited. You'll own the reconciliations, records and close process that make our numbers reliable, working closely with our finance lead, purchasing team and external accountants. The external accountants will continue to handle annual accounts and corporate tax, with local advisors handling tax filings abroad.

This is a hands-on bookkeeping role for someone with at least three years of experience running the full cycle through month-end. Our data and processes need cleaning up. If you enjoy turning a messy administration into a tidy one, this is that job. As you settle in, there is room to take on VAT filing and monthly payroll processing.

The role is based at our Amsterdam HQ, on-site five days a week. Salary is up to €50,000 gross a year, including the 8% holiday allowance.

What you'll do

  • Own daily bookkeeping. Code supplier invoices and card spend in Spendesk with the right GL account, VAT code and cost centre, and post them to the general ledger without re-keying. Keep supplier records clean and prepare payment runs. Supplier bank-detail changes are independently verified and approved; payment approval and release sit with the finance lead.

  • Keep accounts reconciled. Reconcile bank accounts, keep payables and receivables current, and investigate outstanding items so every balance is supported or explained.

  • Run the month-end close. Close all entities to a fixed timetable, initially by working day eight and moving towards working day five. Own accruals, prepayments and balance-sheet reconciliations, collect or prepare foreign entities' figures, agree intercompany balances and reconcile group reporting to the ledgers.

  • Maintain fixed assets and inventory records. Keep the fixed-asset register up to date, including capitalisation and depreciation of our robot fleet under agreed accounting policies, and reconcile inventory accounts to month-end stock values.

  • Prepare Dutch VAT returns. Prepare quarterly btw returns with our external accountants reviewing, and take over filing them over time.

  • Keep the books audit-ready. Maintain supporting schedules and an audit file throughout the year. Be a day-to-day contact for our external accountants and support the audit of our 2027 accounts.

  • Improve how we work. Document the close, fix recurring errors and use spreadsheets, software and AI tools to reduce manual work while checking the results carefully. Depending on your experience, take on payroll processing in Loket over time, with payroll tax filings remaining with our external accountants.

What we're looking for

  • Full-cycle bookkeeping experience. You have at least three years of experience running the books through month-end, at an accounting firm (accountantskantoor) or in-house.

  • Hands-on Dutch VAT experience. You've prepared Dutch btw returns and can work through the supporting records.

  • Strong reconciliation skills. You've handled balance-sheet reconciliations, accruals and prepayments, beyond processing invoices. You investigate differences and follow them through to a resolution.

  • Accuracy and ownership. You keep records organised, meet close deadlines and raise missing information or accounting questions early. You'd rather find the €12 difference than book it to suspense.

  • Fluent English and professional working Dutch. English is our working language, and your manager doesn't speak Dutch. You can independently read and process Dutch invoices, tax correspondence and payroll documents.

  • Comfort with systems and confidential information. You work confidently with spreadsheets, learn new accounting tools and handle financial and employee information carefully.

  • Nice to have: Twinfield, Basecone or Spendesk (Exact, Odoo or similar also counts); multi-entity or multi-country bookkeeping, intercompany and consolidation; fixed-asset or inventory accounting in hardware or manufacturing; statutory audit support; Dutch payroll experience, ideally in Loket; an accounting qualification such as MBO-4/HBO, SPD or Praktijkdiploma Boekhouden; experience automating repetitive work.

Why Monumental?

Joining Monumental means being at the forefront of a movement aimed at making significant strides in the construction industry. Here, your work has the potential to impact not just the company but the future of how we build. If you're driven by innovation, eager to tackle complex challenges, and ready to make a tangible difference, we want to hear from you.

Unfortunately we do not currently support internships.

If you don't meet all the qualifications here but are excited about Monumental and feel you'd still be able to help us tackle complex challenges, do get in touch. We welcome generalists who focus on outcomes and are eager to learn on the job.

jobs.title: System Architect
jobs.description:
Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness.

As a System Architect, you will be responsible for our solid-state transformer as a complete system. You will connect the work of our power electronics, magnetics, and mechanical and thermal engineering teams into one coherent system, and ensure it meets the requirements of hyperscale data center customers.

Instead of specializing in a single subsystem, your mission is to keep the whole system in view: balancing efficiency, size, cost, reliability and manufacturability, guiding the key technical trade-offs, and taking our SST from prototype to a product ready for certification and series production.

This role is for you if…
you’ve owned a complex high-power system rather than one part of it. You enjoy keeping the whole picture in view, making the call on trade-offs between expert teams, and bringing just enough structure to a fast-moving team without slowing it down.

This role isn’t for you if…
you’ve spent your career going deep on a single component or subsystem, or you manage projects without making the technical decisions yourself. It’s also not a fit if you need a fixed specification and established processes before you can start.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the system architecture of the SST and its key performance metrics, including efficiency, power density, cost, thermal performance, reliability, manufacturability and control performance.

  • Coordinate the subsystems of the SST (AC/DC, DC/DC, magnetics, mechanical and thermal) and their interfaces, ensuring the work of each team is compatible and consistent with the system design.

  • Lead system-level trade-off decisions and set technical priorities across teams.

  • Define and maintain system requirements, interface specifications and change management, ensuring design changes are assessed for their impact across the system.

  • Translate the requirements of data center operators and hyperscalers into system specifications, and track how they evolve.

  • Explore and compare different system architectures and their integration in the datacenter power supply chain

  • Drive standardization and design for manufacturing across subsystems in preparation for series production.

  • Work with the compliance and certification team to define a feasible certification path for the system.

  • Identify technical risks at system level early and propose mitigations.

Qualifications

  • MSc or a higher degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.

  • 8+ years of industry experience in developing complex power electronic systems.

  • Proven responsibility at system or platform level, e.g. as system engineer, system architect, technical lead or team lead.

  • Track record of taking power electronic systems from development to series product.

  • Experience with high-power systems such as EV charging, electric drivetrains, rail traction, industrial drives, renewable energy converters or robotics.

  • Broad understanding of the electrical, magnetic, thermal, mechanical and control aspects of power electronic systems, and how they interact.

  • Working knowledge of cooling concepts and the mechanical integration of high-power electronics.

  • Experience with standards, norms and certification processes for power electronic products.

  • Strong communication and decision-making skills; able to align experts across disciplines and drive decisions.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving requirements.

The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with medium-voltage converter systems or solid-state transformers.

  • Knowledge of data center power architectures.

  • Experience in design for manufacturing and cost engineering.

  • Experience establishing systems engineering processes in a growing organization.

Benefits

  • Unique technology and market opportunity – shape the architecture of a new product category for the energy transition.

Role: Senior Design Engineer

Company: Deel

Location: United Kingdom, Israel, Portugal, Spain, Czech Republic, Poland, France, Switzerland, Hungary, Ireland, Sweden, Germany or Estonia

Job Type: Full-time

About Deel

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance and equipment management sit in one product. It supports every worker type in 150+ countries. In 2024, Deel paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits in 109 countries.

The company has a $17.3 billion valuation and reached $1 billion in ARR in just over five years. About 7,000 people work at Deel, across more than 100 countries and 74 languages. Customers rate it 4.83 on average, from 15,000 reviews on G2, Trustpilot, Capterra, Apple and Google.

Most teams use AI as a faster way for humans to build products. Deel wants to go further and build the system that lets AI build the products. Humans set the taste, the guardrails and the standards it works within.

That system is your product. You build what AI generates against: the design system and component architecture, the generation and agent workflows, the quality gates that keep output production-ready, and the feedback loops that keep it all visible to the team. You stay hands-on as a designer, because the quickest way to prove the system works is to ship real interfaces on top of it.

This is a senior individual contributor role in Product Design. You split your time between Figma and a code editor in roughly equal measure. You work directly with design leadership to drive AI adoption across the whole design organisation, and you sit in a cross-functional team with Engineering and Product.

What you are expected to do:

Build the system

  • Architect the design system, tokens and components as the substrate AI generates against.

  • Design prompt libraries, patterns and agent workflows that turn design intent into production-ready UI with minimal human assembly.

Prove it by designing

  • Stay a practising designer. Explore concepts quickly and design real interfaces.

  • Prototype in production front-end code. You are the first and toughest test of whether the system produces excellent, shippable work.

Own quality, guardrails and evals

  • Define production-readiness criteria for AI-generated UI.

  • Set design-to-code fidelity benchmarks, regression safeguards and evaluation methods that keep AI output honest. Speed must not cost craft.

Drive the AI workflow across the design org

  • Work with design leadership to maintain, evolve and roll out the AI-native workflow across the whole design organisation, not only your own work.

  • Treat it as an ongoing responsibility. Drive adoption, keep standards current as tools change, and embed the workflow across teams so it never depends on one person.

Work across functions

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product and design-system contributors. You complement engineering and do not replace it.

  • Keep the system round-tripping to shared surfaces such as Figma. AI-accelerated output stays visible and open to feedback, never a black box.

Push into generative UI

  • Take AI beyond the build process and into the product itself.

  • Prototype and evaluate adaptive, AI-generated interfaces as a product capability, and help decide where they belong on the roadmap.

Level up the team

  • Turn what works into playbooks, prompt libraries and enablement. The wider design org builds on the system and does not depend on you. The goal is durable capability, not tool dependency.

What you need to succeed:

  • You move fluidly between design and code. You don't need to be the deepest specialist in either. You can design something well, build it yourself, and use AI to move quickly between the two.

  • You have real taste for layout, typography, interaction and motion, and you care about polish.

  • You are comfortable writing TypeScript and React, including HTML, CSS and animation. You prototype fast and get from idea to working interface in hours rather than days, moving between Figma and code.

  • You have built or extended design systems that others rely on.

  • You already use AI design and coding tools in real work, and you want to help shape new ones.

  • You have 7+ years in product design and front-end engineering on complex products. You are comfortable with ambiguity, and you set standards others follow.

What you get:

  • Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country.

About the role

Every enterprise wants to be AI-ready, and most are held back by legacy data estates built over decades. Enterprise migrations are a core pillar of our growth strategy, and this role sets the standard for how we deliver them globally. The practice spans the full migration lifecycle:

  • Convert: Automated code conversion with Flowline, our proprietary product, which combines deterministic and LLM-assisted methods. This stage also covers refactoring, optimisation and a first-pass ontology that lays the foundation for AI use cases.

  • Validate: Reconciliation architecture and row-level sign-off, so every migration is provably correct.

2. Knowledge, IP and the asset catalogue

  • Join engagements at scoping and agree what each strategic migration should leave behind (patterns, decisions, failure modes, measurements) and who will capture it.

  • Capture lessons at wave checkpoints, and close each engagement with a review of what worked, what didn’t, and what should change in the standard.

  • Decide which lessons become reusable assets and which stay one-offs.

  • Bring field requirements and recurring challanges to the Flowline product team, and move proven assets into Product & Services.

3. People and enablement

  • Build a global bench of migration specialists. Develop engineers across AMER, EMEA and APAC into a team that can deliver migration waves to our standard, independently and at scale.

  • Own the path from practitioner to leader. Design and run the progression that takes engineers from dbt and Snowflake foundations, through Flowline accreditation and deep expertise in a legacy source system, to owning delivery waves and ultimately leading client assessments.

4. Commercial

  • Make sure live engagements actually use the practice’s accelerators.

  • Make the commercial case for the practice in proposals, extensions and new scope. This includes turning Discovery engagements into migrations and expanding into BI and semantic-layer work.

5. Partners and internal work

  • Act as the technical lead in joint pursuits with Snowflake, Databricks, dbt and Fivetran, and feed what we learn in delivery into joint go-to-market, certifications and co-marketing.

  • Write interview material and run technical interviews for migration roles.

  • Present the practice’s work inside the company and, where it makes sense, at external events and in case studies.

Requirements

  • Ownership at a strategic level. You take full accountability for outcomes, not just tasks. You’ve owned a practice, a service line or a major programme end to end (its direction, quality, people and commercial results), and you’re comfortable making the calls that shape how a business delivers.

  • Enterprise migration experience at scale. You have a track record of leading large, complex migrations off legacy platforms such as Informatica, Talend, Oracle, SSIS or DataStage, and you know where these programmes tend to go wrong.

  • Depth across both ends of the migration. You have hands-on knowledge of legacy source systems and modern platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Iceberg, dbt, Fivetran), plus a structured approach to assessment, conversion and validation.

  • A builder of repeatable delivery. You’ve defined reference architectures, sequencing frameworks and quality gates, and built libraries of reusable assets and accelerators that teams actually use.

  • A multiplier of talent. You’ve developed engineering teams across regions through mentoring, structured skill pathways and accreditation, and you’ve raised the bar for how those teams deliver.

  • Credibility with clients and partners. You can lead discovery sessions with senior client stakeholders, act as the technical lead in joint pursuits with partners such as Snowflake and Databricks, and assess engineering talent in interviews.

  • Commercial awareness. You understand how delivery choices affect scoping, pricing and margin, and you enjoy working with Sales to win the right work.

Line management & how you will be supported

jobs.title: Senior AI R&D Engineer – Model Training  (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Our Mission

Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

Team Culture

At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose.

We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other.

About the Role

As a Senior AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d), you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri.

  • You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals.

  • No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term.

  • We're still building out our training pipeline and infrastructure. Some pieces exist, some do not, and you will have real influence on what gets built and how. Your work directly shapes how quickly we can experiment and improve our models.

  • Identifying issues and taking initiative is what drives our day-to-day work.

  • Working mode, design decisions, priorities are all done in your team together with your team mates.
    The strongest teams often use highly collaborative techniques, like mob or pair programming.

  • Due to the highly collaborative nature of our work you are expected to be on-site at least two days a week. If you are in Berlin, you should expect to travel around every second month for a few days to Heidelberg.

  • We are specifically looking to strengthen the Software Engineering in the teams which are research heavy. Major points include improving the maintainability of our code through tests and design & architecture changes.

Requirements

  • At its core, you need to be able to dive into a codebase, change the behavior as necessary, and after the change the code should be better tested and easier to understand than before.

  • As such we look for candidates for an understanding of how to design for low coupling and high cohesion paired with the ability to incrementally refactor.

  • Experience with the following technologies is likely to be helpful:

    • Test Driven Development (TDD)

    • Trunk based development

    • Continuous integration

    • Domain Driven Design

Nice-to-haves

  • Most of our code is in Python, there is also the occasional Rust codebase.

  • Large parts of our training pipeline are built on top of Kubernetes.

  • We do not hire for skills in a particular technology or language, but rather ability to learn and mindset, yet experience with these technologies is a plus.

What we offer

  • Become part of an AI revolution!

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Access to a variety of fitness & wellness offerings via Wellhub

  • Mental health support through nilo.health

  • Substantially subsidized company pension plan for your future security

  • Subsidized Germany-wide transportation ticket

  • Budget for additional technical equipment

  • Flexible working hours for better work-life balance and hybrid working model

  • JobRad® Bike Lease

jobs.description:
About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe’s software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing.

About Frontu

Frontu is a B2B SaaS Field Service Management (FSM) platform built for the companies that keep the world running - heavy machinery, agriculture, construction, material handling, and mining. Our platform digitises field operations for 7,000+ technicians across 20 countries, plugging directly into existing ERP systems as a powerful mobile layer.

We are part of Everfield, a European private equity group that builds and grows vertical SaaS businesses. Through Everfield, you will be joining a network of 1,000+ professionals across Europe with shared knowledge, resources, and commercial muscle behind you, but at the same time will work with a small 20 person team at Frontu.

We are now expanding into Southern Africa. Frontu is already used by a few companies in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Indian Ocean islands so we need local support in the region.

The Role

This is a hunter role. You will own new business development across Southern Africa. We already have customers in Southern Africa and early traction across the region - proof that the market works. We also come with a mapped prospect database covering the region. What we do not have yet is someone pushing things forward at the pace this opportunity deserves.

This is not a role for someone who needs everything built for them. The foundation is there - customers, data, product. What it needs is someone who moves fast, takes ownership, and turns existing signals into closed deals.

What You Will Do

  • Own the full sales cycle - from prospecting and outbound outreach to discovery, demo, proposal, and close

  • Build pipeline through targeted outbound, referrals, industry events, and partner channels in heavy machinery, agriculture, construction, and material handling verticals

  • Run consultative discovery with your core champions - aftersales directors, service managers, and C-level executives - understand their ERP landscape and position Frontu as the field service layer their technicians are missing

  • Deliver tailored demos and ROI-driven proposals adapted to the buyer context

  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts in CRM (Pipedrive) - we run a tight ship

  • Work closely with Head of Sales on GTM strategy, pricing, and market feedback loops

  • Hand closed accounts to Customer Success

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of B2B sales experience, with a track record of owning and closing full-cycle deals

  • Background in SaaS, ERP, CRM, or adjacent enterprise software - you know what a software sales cycle looks like and how to navigate procurement

  • Native or business-level Afrikaans and professional English (written and spoken - both are required)

  • Self-managed and autonomous - you will operate with a 6 - 8 hour time zone difference from the European team; asynchronous discipline is non-negotiable

  • Consultative, senior selling mindset - you influence C-level and operations stakeholders, not just fill out forms

  • CRM proficiency, ideally Pipedrive

  • Comfortable working as an independent contractor

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience selling to or working with companies running Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, SAP, Sage, AutoIT or similar ERP or DMS systems

  • Industry network or experience in Southern Africa heavy industry (agriculture, construction, material handling, or mining)

What We Offer

  • Competitive OTE with 60% base retainer / 40% variable, uncapped commission

  • First-mover position in a high-growth region with genuine ownership over the region

  • Direct access to Head of Sales and a proven European GTM playbook

  • A clear ICP, competitive battlecards, and battle-tested messaging - you will not be starting from zero

  • Flexible, remote-first setup - no micromanagement, outcome-based working model

  • Access to the Everfield network of 1,000+ professionals across Europe

  • A path to leading the region team as the region grows - we are starting small and building deliberately

Process

  • Screening call with TA 30 min

  • Interview with Hiring Manager 60min

  • interview with Hiring Manager and Managing Director 60min
