jobs.description:
Every team has AI. Few have mastered it. Humans were built to adapt, but AI is now moving faster than most workforces can.

Multiverse is the AI adoption layer: the missing link between the AI tools that companies have invested in and the people expected to use them.

Our ambition is to put AI capability in every worker’s hands. Apprenticeships got us started: we’ve trained over a third of the UK’s data and AI apprentices, worked with a third of the FTSE 100, and generated £2bn+ in verified ROI. Now Mastry, our new adaptive learning platform, takes that further, guiding a company’s AI workforce transformation from start to finish. Mae, our AI guide inside Mastry, is a real-time AI agent that thinks, speaks, listens and sees, working alongside the tools you already use, like Claude and Copilot.

We closed our latest fundraising round in April 2026, with $500m+ raised in total from VC partners including Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Schroders Capital and Lightspeed. With a $2.1bn valuation, we are Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn, and we are just getting started.

If you want to shape how the workforce wins in the AI era, come and join us.

Senior Manager, Coach & Instructor Enablement

FTC 14 months

Coach & Instructor Enablement exists to make the delivery organisation measurably better at retaining learners and delivering successful outcomes consistently, predictably and at scale.

You will enhance our existing strategy and lead the team through its exciting next stage of growth. The team will form around four capability pillars and a new Enablement Operations platform. You will be building that structure while it delivers across a large delivery organisation that supports thousands of learners. Priorities will shift underneath you as delivery data moves, and part of the job is deciding what starts, what stops, and most importantly what must not slip.

This is a role for a strong operator who excels at influencing and collaborating across complex teams and departments. A proven track record of getting work done across teams with clear asks, embedding shared measures of success, and creating an environment where there is no ambiguity about who owns what is are the keys to success within this role.

You will lead a team of six specialists supporting hundreds of coaches and instructors across all learner programmes.

What you'll own

  • Delivery Fundamentals: the standard for what good coaching and instruction look like, QA against that standard, calibration in partnership with Delivery and Quality

  • Operational & Regulatory Change: every coach and instructor has the process, tooling and regulatory knowledge to deliver, and gets it before the change reaches a learner.

  • Technical Skills & Programme Requirements: coaches and instructors are current and designated on the technical content they deliver.

  • Timely Assessment & Achievement: shared ownership for timely learner achievement.

  • Enablement Operations & Systems: the foundation underneath all four.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set the direction and deliver results.. Define the owner, mandate and measures for each pillar, help prioritise and sequence work, and make trade-offs needed to deliver the greatest business impact.

  • Build Enablement Operations SMEs own skills and requirements while operations gets the enablement to the right people, on time, and tracks who did it.

  • Prioritise and re-prioritise without drama. Run a single visible enablement roadmap, say no clearly, and re-sequence when delivery data, business need or regulatory change demands it.

  • Delivering through other teams. Partner with Learning on programme and content change, Operations on process, Quality on the coaching standard, and Delivery on learner retention and achievement.

  • Close the feedback loop with Delivery Leadership. React to performance trends from monthly calibration, observations and delivery data.

  • Lead and develop six specialists through regular 1:1s, feedback, and clear individual measures.

Skills & Qualifications

  • A proven track record of balancing cross functional relationships and their priorities while still delivering impact in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

  • A demonstrable operator. You have taken something loosely defined and made it run: clear owners, measures, cadence, reporting. You are comfortable in the detail and you finish things.

  • Fluent cross-functionally. You have delivered outcomes that depended almost entirely on teams you did not manage, and you can explain exactly how.

  • Comfortable in ambiguity and shifting priorities. You decide on incomplete information, name the risk you are accepting, and change course without losing momentum or the team's confidence.

  • Data-led. You use performance data to decide where to intervene and to hold others accountable.

  • AI-native operator. You build cadences that use AI to do the collating and chasing, so the process scales with the team rather than growing headcount alongside it.

  • Experience of enablement, L&D, capability building, delivery operations or quality in an at-scale frontline organisation.

  • Apprenticeships, regulated education or another regulated delivery environment is a strong advantage. You can hold quality, compliance and pace at the same time.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. You can write the one-pager a senior leader acts on, and run the calibration session a coach finds useful.

Benefits

  • Time off: 27 days holiday (including 3 winter shutdown days) and bank holidays, plus 5 extra days off (1 life event, 2 volunteer days and 2 summer shutdown days).

  • Health and wellbeing: Bupa private medical insurance, a medical cash back plan, therapy through Spill and gym access through Wellhub.

  • Equity for all: we believe that when Multiverse wins, we all win, which is why every permanent employee receives share options.

  • Financial security: life insurance at 3x salary, a workplace pension with 4% contribution from us, Cycle to Work and a Tech Scheme.

  • Family support: enhanced maternity and paternity leave, adoption and shared parental leave, paid leave after pregnancy loss, and a workplace nursery scheme.

  • Hybrid working: 3 days a week in the office - except for Coaches & Instructors who come into the office 1 day per month. Plus 10 days a year to work from anywhere.

  • Work perks: quarterly team socials, company-wide events, happy hours, lunch delivered to the office once a week, fully stocked snack bar and a drinks fridge!

  • Lead the renewal process for each account, ensuring customers needs are met, checkins are scheduled and commercial terms align with customer needs and expectations.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer III, Maps API
jobs.description:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

The Maps API team builds and maintains the applications and infrastructure responsible for creating and distributing Mapbox maps. Thousands of customers rely on our services to seamlessly handle billions of requests every day, scale in real-time to global events, and enable designers, developers, and analysts to make and share maps we’ve never dreamed of.

Delivering maps means delivering a model of the world that’s changing all the time and needs to automatically support the world’s edge cases – writing systems, fonts, local regulations, and global boundary disputes.

Our team maintains the highest-traffic read APIs at Mapbox and the distributed ETL pipelines used by internal and external customers to turn data into maps. We’re building new ways for people to visualize location data. Check out our Mapbox maps!

As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow.

What You’ll Do

As a Software Development Engineer III on the Maps API team, you will be responsible for balancing rapid development of new mapping tools against the reliability of our services as they scale into new request volumes, markets, and use cases. In a single week on the Maps API team, you might write application code robust to a world’s worth of data, build and deploy microservices, diagnose complex system behavior as global markets drive traffic in unexpected ways, or facilitate continuous delivery at Mapbox.

In this role, you can expect to:

  • Lead your engineering team to identify and scope out well-defined tasks.

  • Execute on the scope and be accountable for delivering on time with quality.

  • Design systems and make architectural decisions that will keep pace with the rapid growth of Mapbox’s customer base.

  • Mentor your peers through 1:1s, facilitating design and code reviews, and providing continuous guidance to foster professional growth and technical excellence.

  • Promote a culture of operational excellence by meticulously testing and monitoring our systems and code, writing documentation, and being on-call to support the health of our services.

  • Reduce technical debt, share your knowledge, and invest in your teammates’ health and happiness, while optimizing application performance and accelerating feature velocity.

  • Uphold a culture of collaboration, transparency, creativity, inclusion, and data-driven decisions.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • 8-10+ years of experience building scalable high volume low latency backend services.

  • Proficiency with Python, NodeJS, and native AWS (CDK, ECS, Step Functions, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, CloudFront).

  • Experience building mapping and geospatial related products.

  • Familiarity with code versioning tools, such as GitHub.

  • Able to perform independently all the development tasks, based on designs and specs.

  • Self-starter who is communication and outcomes-oriented.

  • An empirical analytical approach. You develop strong hypotheses, conduct spikes, and clearly communicate your findings.

  • A desire to share your expertise through documentation, mentorship, pairing, and both written and verbal discussion.

  • A desire to work with and lead individuals with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

  • High quality mindset -- write unit tests, proactively remedy defects and follow through to production.

Nice to Have Traits for This Role

  • Proficiency in C++

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

How we support you

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.

  • Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth

  • Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

  • Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

jobs.title: Gestionnaire Paie & RH H/F
jobs.description:
À propos d'Everfield

Everfield achète, développe et accompagne la croissance d'éditeurs de logiciels métiers et spécialisés en Europe, en leur donnant les clés pour franchir un cap. Notre mission : nourrir l'ambition, alimenter la croissance et révéler le potentiel de l'écosystème logiciel européen.

Les entreprises de l'écosystème Everfield évoluent selon un modèle décentralisé : elles conservent leur équipe, leur marque et leurs bureaux, et se concentrent sur ce qu'elles font de mieux, développer leurs produits et accompagner leurs clients. Everfield les épaule sur le recrutement et les RH, et leur donne accès à une équipe d'experts qui les conseille sur les aspects financiers et opérationnels de la construction et de la croissance des entreprises B2B SaaS européennes. Fondé en 2022, Everfield est déjà présent dans 10 pays, et continue de se développer.

Rôle

En tant que Gestionnaire Paie & RH, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans le bon fonctionnement des opérations RH au sein des sociétés du portefeuille ( sous la convention Syntec). En étroite collaboration avec l'équipe HR Business Partnering Europe, vous gérerez l'administration RH, coordonnerez la paie et fournirez des données et rapports précis pour appuyer la prise de décision. Vous travaillez avec un prestataire de paie externe.

Vous serez le premier point de contact pour les questions RH quotidiennes des collaborateurs, en garantissant un support RH rapide, précis et conforme. Ce rôle constitue le socle d'une gestion RH efficace, permettant aux dirigeants et aux HRBP de se concentrer sur les priorités stratégiques.

Responsabilités clés (liste non exhaustive)

  • Paie : préparer, contrôler et valider la paie mensuelle de plusieurs entités avec le prestataire externe ; gérer la DSN, les arrêts maladie, maternité et invalidité, la subrogation, la relation avec la CPAM, la mutuelle et la prévoyance ; mettre à jour les taux de cotisation et appliquer les minima et règles Syntec.

  • Administration RH : contrats et avenants, absences, avantages sociaux, dossiers du personnel prêts pour un audit.

  • Gestion des intégrations et des sorties : piloter le cycle d'entrée et de sortie des collaborateurs de bout en bout.

    • Intégrations : DPAE, contrat de travail, affiliation mutuelle et prévoyance, visite d'information et de prévention, création dans le SIRH et la paie, coordination de l'accueil avec les managers et suivi de la période d'essai.

    • Sorties : démissions, ruptures conventionnelles (homologation), licenciements, fins de période d'essai ; calcul du préavis et des indemnités selon Syntec, solde de tout compte, certificat de travail, attestation France Travail, portabilité mutuelle et prévoyance, restitution du matériel et clôture des accès.

  • Premier point de contact RH pour les collaborateurs, en français et en anglais.

  • Données et reporting : fiabilité des données dans le SIRH (Workday) et rapports pour les équipes RH et Finance, en anglais.

  • Appui aux HRBP : documentation disciplinaire, entretiens de sortie, déploiement de programmes RH.

Ce que nous recherchons (indispensable)

  • 3 ans minimum en gestion de paie française, dont au moins 2 ans sous la convention Syntec.

  • Maîtrise de la DSN et des absences complexes (maladie, maternité, invalidité, prévoyance).

  • Anglais courant (C1 minimum) : réunions, échanges écrits et reporting en anglais chaque semaine.

  • Bonne connaissance du droit du travail français.

  • Rigueur, discrétion et capacité à gérer plusieurs entités en parallèle.

  • Expérience de Workday ou d'un autre SIRH international.

  • Expérience en multi-entités, en cabinet de paie ou dans une ESN.

 

Localisation : France (Télétravail avec des déplacements ponctuels en France)

jobs.title: Head of Electronics & software
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Head of Electronics & Software

Purpose

We are looking for a Head of Electronics & Software to lead and develop the engineering capability behind some of the most critical systems in our spacecraft.

This is a senior leadership role combining people leadership, engineering excellence, organisational development and technical breadth. You will lead a multidisciplinary organisation spanning:

  • Avionics, communications and electrical power systems

  • Flight software (FSW)

  • Guidance, navigation and control (GNC)

  • Electrical wiring and interconnection systems (EWIS), including harness engineering

  • Future projects and advanced electronics and software development

You will be responsible for ensuring our teams have the people, skills, processes, tools and engineering standards needed to deliver ambitious space programmes today, while building the capabilities we will need for the future.

This is not a role for someone looking to step away from engineering. We are looking for a leader who can engage credibly with highly technical teams, challenge constructively, develop strong technical leaders and help create an environment where exceptional engineering can happen.

Matrix Organisation

Our engineering teams work in a matrix organisation, combining strong functional leadership with project-based delivery.

As Head of Electronics & Software, you will lead the functional organisation, developing its people and capabilities while working closely with Project Managers, Project Chief Engineers, technical authorities and engineering Leads responsible for programme delivery.

You will:

  • Lead and develop Project Leads, discipline Leads, Principal Engineers and transversal engineering resources

  • Partner with project leadership to align capability, resources and priorities with programme needs

  • Help teams navigate competing priorities across projects

  • Ensure clear ownership and accountability between functional leadership and project execution

  • Build an organisation capable of supporting multiple programmes as the company grows

Success in this environment requires collaboration, influence and sound engineering judgement rather than centralising every technical decision.

Role Boundaries

This role owns the strength and effectiveness of the Electronics & Software organisation: its people, capability, engineering practices, tools, standards and functional budget.

You will create the environment in which our technical teams can perform at their best, providing mentoring, challenge and access to expertise while supporting technical and project leadership in making strong engineering decisions.

Project technical decisions and product technical authority remain within the relevant project and technical organisations. Your role is to ensure they are supported by a highly capable engineering organisation with the right expertise, methods and resources.

Key Responsibilities

People, Hiring & Organisation

You will build and shape a high-performing Electronics & Software organisation.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning workforce and headcount planning across the function

  • Recruiting and retaining exceptional engineering talent

  • Developing clear job families, role levels and assessment standards

  • Partnering with Talent Acquisition, engineering Leads and hiring managers to maintain a high technical hiring bar

  • Leading promotion, compensation and organisational planning within the function

  • Building succession plans and reducing key-person dependencies in specialist areas

  • Creating an organisation that remains lean, scalable and aligned with current and future programme needs

Line Management & Development

Developing strong engineers and technical leaders will be a major part of the role.

You will:

  • Lead and develop the managers, Leads and senior engineers within your organisation

  • Establish meaningful objectives aligned with project and company priorities

  • Build clear development and technical career paths

  • Strengthen mentoring, coaching and leadership capability across the organisation

  • Create opportunities for engineers to gain experience across design, integration, test and operations

  • Address performance challenges fairly and constructively

  • Build a culture where progression is based on demonstrated capability, impact and organisational need

Engineering Processes, Standards & Compliance

You will help define how excellent electronics and software engineering is done across the company.

This includes:

  • Owning and continuously improving engineering practices across electronics, software, GNC and electrical/harness engineering

  • Establishing practical standards for electronics design, software development, testing, modelling, reviews and verification

  • Ensuring teams understand and can effectively apply the relevant processes

  • Supporting certification readiness, audits and continuous improvement, including applicable EN9100 requirements

  • Working closely with Quality, Safety, Systems Engineering and the Chief Engineer organisation

  • Using lessons from development, testing and operations to continuously improve engineering practices

Our aim is not process for process's sake. We want processes that are lean, pragmatic and proportionate to engineering risk.

Engineering Tools & Ways of Working

You will ensure our engineers have the tools and engineering environment needed to work effectively and at scale.

This includes capability across:

  • Electronics and PCB design

  • Harness CAD

  • Software development, build and configuration toolchains

  • Automated testing

  • GNC analysis and modelling

  • Software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop environments

  • Simulation and shared test infrastructure

You will drive standardisation, adoption and good engineering practice while partnering with Digital, IT, Procurement, Quality and other engineering teams.

The goal is simple: engineering work should be efficient, traceable, reproducible and ready to scale.

Project Support & Resource Planning

You will work closely with our projects to ensure they have access to the Electronics & Software capability they need.

You will:

  • Mentor engineering Leads and provide senior technical guidance where needed

  • Support major technical and engineering reviews

  • Maintain visibility of capability gaps, resource constraints and significant engineering risks

  • Work with project leadership to resolve resource requirements through hiring, development, internal mobility or external support

  • Anticipate future capacity constraints before they become programme blockers

  • Help resolve cross-project resource and organisational conflicts

  • Contribute to the company-wide electronics and software strategy alongside the Chief of Engineering and CTO

  • Shape future capabilities, reusable technologies, R&D priorities and obsolescence strategies

Budget

You will own the Electronics & Software functional budget and forecast, including:

  • Headcount and personnel planning

  • Engineering tools and licences

  • Relevant shared simulation and test capability

  • Training and development

  • Functional team travel

You will work closely with Finance, Procurement, Digital and project leadership to ensure investment supports both immediate programme needs and longer-term engineering capability.

Requirements

We are looking for someone who combines credible engineering depth with proven organisational leadership.

You should bring:

  • Strong hands-on engineering experience in at least one of the following: avionics, electronics, embedded systems, flight software, GNC or electrical systems

  • Enough technical breadth to operate effectively across several of these disciplines and understand how they interact

  • Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams in a complex product environment

  • Proven formal line-management experience, including developing managers and technical leaders

  • Experience hiring, developing and building engineering organisations

  • Experience with organisational design, workforce and capacity planning

  • Experience creating or improving engineering processes, tools, standards and ways of working

  • Experience operating within a matrix organisation and supporting multiple projects or programmes

  • Strong coaching, mentoring, communication and influencing skills

  • The technical credibility to challenge senior engineers while empowering the appropriate technical owners to make decisions

  • A pragmatic approach to engineering quality, assurance and compliance, including relevant EN9100 practices

Experience in spacecraft, launch vehicles, aerospace, defence, aviation, robotics or another complex safety-critical engineering environment would be particularly relevant.

We are looking for a leader who:

  • Leads with high standards, humility and low ego

  • Enjoys developing people rather than simply directing them

  • Empowers strong technical Leads and avoids becoming a bottleneck

  • Can challenge experienced engineers constructively

  • Makes decisions using data and sound engineering judgement

  • Balances immediate programme pressures with long-term organisational capability

  • Creates clarity where responsibilities cross organisational boundaries

  • Promotes transparency, accountability, collaboration and continuous learning

  • Believes in extreme ownership and engineering first principles

  • Remains close enough to the engineering to understand the challenges our teams are solving

Location & Travel

This is a leadership role with teams and stakeholders across our European organisation, so regular face-to-face engagement is important.

You should expect to spend time across our main European sites, with additional travel where required for team leadership, recruitment, major engineering reviews, audits and project support.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?

    • Develop and implement comprehensive EMC/EMI test plans and procedures for spacecraft systems.

    • Conduct EMC/EMI testing, including pre-compliance and compliance testing.

    • Analyze test data, identify non-conformities, and recommend corrective actions to resolve EMC/EMI issues.

About the Role

Hi there! We're hiring an Enterprise Account Executive GCC to join our Sales team in UAE.

Our sales team is tenured, technically curious, and genuinely invested in doing right by the customer. We partner closely across the business, and we operate with a lot of trust: you're given real ownership over your territory, and you're expected to bring your own judgment to how you build it.

This role gives you a book of enterprise accounts to grow and a real say in how you build your territory. You'll work complex, multi-stakeholder deals, and you'll have the backing of sales engineering and customer success behind you as you build credibility and close.

As an Enterprise Account Executive II, you'll own the full sales cycle for a defined set of enterprise accounts, from first conversation through negotiation and close, partnering with sales engineering, customer success, and your manager to navigate complex deals. This role matters because enterprise wins are how Camunda grows its footprint in large accounts, and how we prove the platform works at scale.

What You Will Do

  • Build a territory plan that identifies land opportunities and expand possibilities, leveraging extended resources like partners, marketing, and customer success.

  • Build account plans that identify whitespace, map stakeholders, and set a realistic path to close.

  • Navigate multi-stakeholder buying committees, including technical, business, and economic buyers.

  • Own and execute the full sales cycle, from prospecting through negotiation and close.

  • Partner with sales engineering and customer success to build technical credibility and ensure a smooth handoff and adoption after close.

  • Manage pipeline and forecast with discipline and accuracy.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • Must have proven product sales experience in Oman, Qatar

  • Must have proven experience in outbound sales and pipeline generation.

  • Solid experience closing enterprise software deals end-to-end, with a track record across multiple full sales cycles. You know what it takes to move a deal from first meeting to signature without losing momentum.

  • Comfort navigating multi-stakeholder enterprise environments. You've worked complex deals involving IT, business, and procurement stakeholders, and you know how to keep everyone moving in the same direction.

  • Developing territory and account planning instincts, with the ability to orchestrate resources efficiently. You can build a plan with some independence, not just work from a list handed to you.

  • Comfort selling technical products. Experience with process automation, integration platforms, middleware, or similar technical software is a real advantage, since you'll regularly be in the room with engineering and IT buyers.

  • Negotiation experience under real pressure. You know where to hold firm and where to flex, and you can explain your reasoning either way.

  • A relationship-building style that goes beyond the transaction. You've had customers start to treat you as an advisor, not just a vendor.

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

jobs.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

ProcessOS is a new kind of Camunda product: business processes described in natural language, generated as executable BPMN workflows, and improved autonomously from production data. We’re hiring the first cohort of Forward Deployed Engineers to bring it into production at enterprise customers. You’ll own the deployment journey from first process file to a working, improving system, and hand off a functioning capability to the customer’s team. The code you write and the patterns you discover feed directly back into how ProcessOS is built. This is a rare opportunity to shape a product, a function, and a field practice from day one.

You’ll work end‑to‑end across Java services and React interfaces, collaborating closely with a talented global team to measure, improve, and scale performance and fault tolerance in real-world distributed systems.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Deploy and prove. Own the journey from first process file to production workflow. At 90 days: at least one workflow running, the improvement loop active, and measurable fitness gains the customer can see. At 12 months: 3–5 customers with viable deployments.

  • Drive organizational adoption. Work across technical and business stakeholders to build understanding and trust, turning early deployments into lasting customer capability.

  • Work at depth technically. Configure and run Camunda clusters locally and in cloud environments. Debug integration failures. Build custom agents where platform defaults don’t fit. Write connector logic that gets legacy enterprise systems talking to ProcessOS.

  • Build the playbook. There is no deployment template yet. Document what good looks like as you discover it, and make the next implementation faster.

  • Feed the product. Custom agents you write get contributed back. Integration patterns get codified. Production bugs you find, you often fix. Your field work is a direct input to ProcessOS.

  • Hand off deliberately. Leave customers with a team that can operate independently, is trained on the platform, and acts on improvement results without you.

What You Will Bring to the Role

Must Haves:

  • Enterprise production experience: you’ve shipped something inside a large organization and stayed to see it operate. You know why governance and resilience matter at scale.

  • Technical depth: You can debug an integration failure, write a custom agent against a legacy API, stand up a Camunda cluster from scratch, and explain generated BPMN to both engineers and business leads.

  • Stakeholder communication: you work effectively across engineering, architecture, and business leadership and adapt how you communicate without losing precision.

  • Practical AI experience: you’ve used AI to solve real problems in production – not just experimented. You understand context management, prompt engineering, agent testing, and integration tradeoffs.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: you make sound judgment calls without a playbook and document what you learn.

  • Occasional travel may be required

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience in a customer-facing engineering or professional services role.

  • Familiarity with regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or insurance

  • Production experience with agentic systems or AI-integrated workflows.

  • Contributions to a shared platform or open source project that others built on.

     Experience in Sales Engineering or Pre-Sales, with a deep understanding of sales cycles, value-based selling, and stakeholder engagement. Skilled in handling objections and driving deals to closure in a consultative selling environment.

     Exceptional presentation and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives tailored to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Location AI
jobs.description:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What you'll do

This role is scoped by skill rather than by product. The problems below span multiple departments and show up across our Search and Places data work, our Location and Navigation Intelligence work, and the Platform work that makes Mapbox usable by agents. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands.

At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area.

In this role, you will:

  • Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. Formulate hypotheses around the products we build and seek the signal needed to validate them. Define what a correct result is for a given input and state, determine whether to assemble datasets from real usage or hand-written cases, and gate changes on regression results.

  • Run continuous evaluation of the products we build, whether APIs, SDKs, data representations, or reference applications, from the position of the end user, whether developer, agent, or consumer. Assess the gaps such as misuse of parameters or integration anti-patterns, recommend the fixes, and make sure they land.

  • Own the MVP against an agreed north star technical design, and balance technical perfection against shipping useful increments.

  • Build data pipelines and the tooling around them: ingestion, conflation, entity resolution, quality checks, and the batch and streaming jobs that keep a large dataset current.

  • Track and pull external datasets, models, and benchmarks from published research and open-source releases. Evaluate what fits the problem and constraints , and decide when to adopt what exists versus build your own.

  • Design feedback loops so that using a product generates data that improves it. Instrument systems so failures arrive with enough context to reproduce, then turn the recurring ones into evaluation cases.

  • Design the boundary between a model and the tools it calls. Build or improve the model harness, decide what the model handles, what it delegates, and how to keep it working from the state it actually fetched.

  • Work to a latency and cost target per request: streaming, partial results, caching, model routing, prompt structure.

  • Build the internal harnesses and tools (CLI, MCP, and others) your team needs to iterate quickly, and share the parts that generalize with other teams.

  • Raise the bar on your team through code and design review, and bring other engineers up on eval practice.

  • Some of the technical questions in this area are still open. You will help answer them.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • Bachelors degree in STEM discipline and 5+ years of software engineering experience, with production ownership of services, pipelines, or SDKs.

  • 2+ years shipping LLM-backed features to real users, in systems that carried error budgets, on-call rotations, and customers who noticed regressions.

  • Direct experience or deep understanding of designing evaluations for non-deterministic systems. You can describe a dataset you built and the failure it caught.

  • Data engineering depth: SQL, at least one distributed processing framework, and experience with pipelines where a wrong record mattered more than a slow one.

  • Fluency with tool calling and agent orchestration, including the failure modes: stale context, hallucinated arguments, silent partial success, unbounded loops.

  • Working knowledge of more than one agent harness, and opinions about where each of them is weak.

  • Strong Python or TypeScript, and comfort reading code in whatever language the caller happens to be written in.

  • Experience diagnosing latency in a distributed request path.

  • Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to ship something narrow that works while the general solution is still unclear.

  • Clear written communication. Mapbox is distributed across time zones and we make most decisions in documents and Slack.

Nice to have traits for this role

  • Geospatial data experience: routing, geocoding, POI or address data, OpenStreetMap, or conflation of overlapping sources.

  • Public API or SDK design experience, particularly for developers you never talk to.

  • Experience building against MCP or similar tool transports.

  • Experience running evals in CI, with a commercial harness or one you built.

  • Automotive, in-vehicle infotainment, CarPlay, or Android Auto experience.

  • Voice pipeline experience: streaming ASR, TTS, barge-in, endpointing, wake word.

  • Work under constrained compute, offline, or intermittent connectivity.

  • Experience operating a product through its first external integrations, where the customer finds the gaps before you do.

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

 

How we support you

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.

  • Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth

  • Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

  • Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have received the Mapbox Non-US Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here. Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application.

We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class.

  • Thought Leadership: Help shape Strategic Intelligence's point of view on creator measurement, contributing to frameworks, benchmarks, and content that elevate CreatorIQ in the market.

Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.


At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.

Mission

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will deliver fast, reliable, API-driven integrations for our largest customers by translating business workflows into scalable, repeatable technical solutions. You will partner closely with Sales and Customer Success to deliver best-in-class integration experiences that drive adoption and long-term success. This role is primarily customer-facing, with a strong focus on solution design and customer outcomes rather than traditional software development. You'll build integrations primarily with low-code tools, using light scripting where needed.

  • Independently design, build, and deliver complex, scalable, and secure integrations between Choco and customer systems using low-code tools (e.g. n8n and Tray.ai).

  • Collaborate closely with Customer Success, Implementation, and Product teams, providing technical guidance, documenting integration designs, and influencing product improvements based on customer needs.

  • Mentor junior Solutions Engineers, providing technical guidance, sharing expertise, and supporting their development through complex projects.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in solutions engineering, IT/ERP consulting, or systems integration.

jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About The Job

As a Forward Software Engineer, you will build the systems behind some of the hardest problems Mistral takes on.

You join our team of engineers in Applied AI. We gravitate towards hard problems, decide how to solve them, and ship fast. You work closely with our customer-facing teams, and what works goes into production with our customers and across the company. When a project needs it, you work directly on customer engagements.

We're looking for a strong software engineer who has shipped agentic or GenAI systems to production. You've felt the pain of agents that work in the demo and fall apart on real tasks: tool calls that fail silently, loops that never end, and quality that drifts after launch. That production depth is your edge. You build across the stack, and you'd rather ship a plain UI on a solid foundation than a polished UI on a fragile one.

You think like a founder. You start from the customer's problem, not the technology. You measure success by the value you deliver, and you care about building experiences people love to use. You like working at the edge of what AI can do today, and you push past it.

Your scope is end to end, from first prototype to production. You help set the standard for how the team builds agents that are reliable, observable, and safe to run against sensitive systems.

Security is a big part of where we're heading. If you're drawn to it, that's a strong plus. You might come from security with a real interest in AI engineering, or from AI engineering with a real interest in security. Both paths fit. Curiosity about how systems break, and a habit of learning fast from the people who know the domain, matter. Experience at a security company counts too.


What you will do

  • Build AI systems end to end, from first prototype to production.

  • Design the agent architecture: orchestration, tool use, memory, retrieval, and the interfaces between agents and the systems they act on.

  • Build across the stack, from backend services and APIs to the interfaces people use to work with agents.

  • Turn what works for one customer into patterns and platforms that work across many, without rebuilding each time.

  • Make systems hold up under real load: throughput, latency, cost, and failure recovery are part of the design from the start.

  • Build security into agents from day one: permissions, sandboxing, prompt-injection defenses, and audit trails for agents that touch sensitive systems.

  • Build the evaluation loop: task-level evals, tracing, and checks that catch agent failures and quality drift before customers do.

  • Work with researchers, engineers, and customer-facing teams to turn hard problems into systems people rely on.


What We're Looking For

  • You have 5+ years building production software, with at least one agentic or GenAI system shipped to production that you ran after launch.

  • You have full ability to ship across the stack: proficient NodeJS e.g. NextJS/Express/Fastify or similar or Python e.g. FastAPI. You are confident with TypeScript + React/NextJS or similar. Solid beats polished.

  • You have hands-on depth in agent design: orchestration, tool use, retrieval, evaluation, and the ways agents fail in the real world.

  • You work autonomously: you find the problem, decide the approach, and own the outcome.

  • You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, and are fluent in English.

  • You ship in increments and are obsessed with time to value

  • You have product judgment: you learn what users need through customer-facing teams, cut scope hard, and care how the result feels to use.

Ideally you have

  • Open-source contributions, particularly in agents or LLMs.

  • Experience deploying and running what you build: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and AWS, GCP, or Azure.

  • A security background in application, cloud, or AI security, such as prompt injection, securing agents, or supply chain (SBOM, SLSA). If that's you, flag it in your application.

  • Experience building for security workflows, such as alert triage, threat hunting, or investigation agents, or with SIEM, XDR, or SOAR tooling.


How We Work in Applied AI

  • We care about people and outputs.

  • What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it

  • Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week.

  • Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before

  • We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care.

  • No politics. Low ego, high standards.

  • We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

jobs.title: Privacy & AI Officer
jobs.description:
Wil jij bijdragen aan een organisatie die in control is op het gebied van privacy en verantwoorde inzet van AI? En weet jij wet- en regelgeving te vertalen naar duidelijke processen en praktisch advies? Als Privacy & AI Officer help je afdelingen zorgvuldig om te gaan met persoonsgegevens en AI-risico’s tijdig te herkennen. Je adviseert, coördineert, bewaakt en rapporteert. Zo maak jij het verschil voor onze leden, collega’s en de continuïteit van Univé Zuid-Nederland!

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een toegankelijke professional met een passie voor privacybescherming en verantwoorde AI-governance. Je hebt een scherp oog voor risico’s en verbindt beleid, processen en praktijk op een natuurlijke manier. Met jouw analytisch vermogen en zorgvuldige oordeelsvorming help je de organisatie risico’s tijdig te herkennen en beheersen. Je schakelt makkelijk met collega’s, management en andere belanghebbenden en maakt complexe onderwerpen helder en praktisch.

 

Daarnaast breng je mee:

  • Hbo+ werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een juridische richting.

  • Diepgaande kennis van de AVG, privacywetgeving en relevante wet- en regelgeving.

  • Praktische kennis van de AVG en ervaring met bijvoorbeeld DPIA’s, datalekken of privacyprocessen.

  • Kennis van en interesse in AI-governance, AI-beleid, de AI Act en het beheersen van AI-risico’s.

  • Ervaring met het implementeren en bewaken van beleid, regelingen en processen.

  • Sterk analytisch vermogen, zorgvuldige oordeelsvorming en resultaatgerichtheid.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om belanghebbenden mee te nemen.

 

Wat ga je doen

Als Privacy en AI Officer ondersteun je afdelingen bij het naleven van de AVG, het Univé privacybeleid en het AI-beleid. Maar pak je ook (pro-)actief zelf activiteiten op in het kader van dit aandachtsgebied. Je hebt een spilfunctie in het vroegtijdig onderkennen en beheersen van privacy- en AI-risico’s. Je adviseert je collega’s in de eerste lijn, coördineert de implementatie van beleid en zorgt voor het onderhoud en de naleving van privacy-instrumenten en processen.

 

Daarnaast registreer, coördineer en beheer je AI-toepassingen, AI-risico’s en relevante beheersmaatregelen. Je helpt bij AI-use cases, naleving van wet- en regelgeving en verantwoord gebruik en rapporteert hierover. Ook speel je een actieve rol in beleidsontwikkeling en advisering. Je volgt wijzigingen in wet- en regelgeving en vertaalt deze naar de praktijk. Zo help je Univé Zuid-Nederland om aantoonbaar in control te blijven. Het zwaartepunt van de functie ligt bij privacy, waarmee jij vanuit de eerste lijn waarde toevoegt in dit domein. AI speelt daarin een aanvullende rol en er is ruimte om je hierin verder te ontwikkelen, net als de organisatie dat doet. Je adviseert niet alleen: je helpt ook zelf bij de uitvoering waarbij je samenwerkt met de eerste lijn business owners. Juist die combinatie maakt deze functie afwisselend en zichtbaar waardevol voor de organisatie.

 

Hieronder een greep uit jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Je helpt afdelingen bij privacy, AVG, AI-beleid en relevante wet- en regelgeving.

  • Je coördineert de implementatie, naleving en doorontwikkeling van beleid en processen.

  • Je registreert, coördineert Privacy- en AI-risico’s en zorgt voor opvolging en borging van de (beheers)maatregelen.           

  • Je signaleert risico’s, ontwikkelingen en verbeterkansen en vertaalt deze naar duidelijke acties.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met de 2e lijn Risk & Compliance

 

Wat wij bieden

Een veelzijdige functie van 32 uur per week met directe lijnen naar de bestuurder, ruimte voor eigen initiatief en mogelijkheden om je professioneel te ontwikkelen. Je werkt aan onderwerpen die ertoe doen voor onze leden en collega’s, binnen een coöperatieve organisatie waarin samenwerken en verantwoordelijkheid nemen centraal staan. Daarbovenop kun je rekenen op:

  • Een brutosalaris tussen de € 3.859 en € 5.358 per maand, exclusief vakantiegeld, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring.

  • Een contract van 1 jaar met de intentie voor een vaste aanstelling.

  • Een 13e maand, bedrijfsfitnessregeling, fietsregeling en een goede pensioenregeling.

  • 25 vakantiedagen en 13 compensatie dagen bij een fulltime dienstverband.

  • Een zelfstandige en verantwoordelijke functie binnen een betrouwbare organisatie.

  • Uitstekende werksfeer; plezier in je werk staat bij ons voorop.

  • Aantrekkelijke kortingen op onze verzekeringsproducten en diensten.

 

Wie wij zijn

Univé Zuid-Nederland is één van de acht regionale Univé’s, een coöperatie met de missie om de meest menselijke financiële dienstverlener van Nederland te zijn. Ons werkgebied bestaat uit Noord-Brabant, Limburg, Zeeland en delen van Utrecht, Gelderland en Zuid-Holland. Wij zijn verzekeraar en bemiddelaar in schade- en levensverzekeringen, voor zowel de particuliere als zakelijke markt. Daarnaast zijn wij ook erkend hypotheekadviseur. Onze belofte, persoonlijk en dichtbij, komt tot leven in onze lokale dienstverlening, samenwerkingen en sponsoring. Het mooiste van Univé? Dat zijn de mensen, de geschiedenis, de cultuur en de betrokkenheid. A Great Place to Work!

Wat ga je doen?

Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf.

  • Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers.

  • Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf.

  • Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg.

Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar.

Van KYC tot complexe financiële processen

Je kent de werkelijkheid achter KYC/AML, klantacceptatie, klachten- en schadeafhandeling, financiële rapportage, risk en compliance. Denk aan:

  • KYC-dossiers die agents voorbereiden met herleidbare bronnen, zodat analisten sneller onderbouwd beslissen.

Wat breng je mee?

jobs.title: Onderzoeksstage Water en Ruimte
jobs.description:
24-40 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | € 600,- stagevergoeding | Wo-bachelor/-master

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Waterbeheer heeft wonen, werken en leven in Nederland mogelijk gemaakt. Dat systeem is over honderden jaren opgebouwd en ingericht op een gematigd klimaat. Met zeespiegelstijging, droogte en zware neerslag lopen we nu tegen de grenzen aan. Drinkwaterbedrijven luiden de noodklok over leveringszekerheid en piekbuien wisselen af met extreme droogte. Water is bepalend voor waar we kunnen bouwen, werken en leven. Om weerbaar te worden moeten we andere keuzes maken over de inrichting en het gebruik van onze leefomgeving, waarbij functies beter aansluiten op de draagkracht van het water- en bodemsysteem.

Elke dag worden er nieuwe ruimtelijke keuzes gemaakt, bijvoorbeeld over woningbouw, bedrijfsuitbreiding of het energiesysteem. Om daarin meer rekening te houden met water en bodem moeten de wereld van water en bodem en de wereld van ruimtelijke ordening beter samenwerken en elkaars taal leren spreken. Daarvoor bestaan al instrumenten, methoden en werkwijzen, zoals Omgevingstafels, de Watertoets, blauwe omgevingsvisies en water- en bodemsysteemanalyses. Maar werken die instrumenten ook echt, en wat is er nodig om ze beter te laten aansluiten op de praktijk? Dat zoeken wij uit.

Wil jij aan het begin van jouw loopbaan direct meewerken aan onderzoek dat bijdraagt aan de koers van Nederland? Bij Berenschot werk je in een dynamisch team van adviseurs op het gebied van water en ruimte. Je krijgt de kans om jezelf te ontwikkelen én tegelijkertijd maatschappelijke impact te maken.

Dit ga je doen

Jouw onderzoek:

Je maakt een inventarisatie van bestaande en nieuwe, innovatieve instrumenten en methoden, en/of je formuleert succesfactoren voor één specifiek instrument (een best practice). Samen met jou en je begeleiders bepalen we de precieze afbakening.

Je onderzoek is onderdeel van het project Kwartiermaker water- en bodemsysteemanalyses (Interprovinciaal Overleg en het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat). Mogelijke resultaten zijn een bijdrage aan de analyse en toolbox van het kwartiermakerschap, een publicatie over best practices, of een instrumentenkoffer voor waterschappen, provincies en het ministerie van IenW.

Je bent daarmee onderdeel van het kwartiermakerverhaal, maar blijft niet bij één project. Voor je onderzoek kun je ook putten uit andere lopende trajecten van ons team, zoals het Deltaprogramma Ruimtelijke Adaptatie (DPRA). Daar spelen vergelijkbare vragen over hoe je samenwerking tussen overheden en regio’s echt werkend krijgt. Zo haal je extra inzichten en praktijkvoorbeelden op en zie je hoe verschillende dossiers elkaar versterken.

Naast je eigen onderzoek werk samen met een team van ervaren adviseurs aan maatschappelijke dossiers voor ministeries, provincies, waterschappen en drinkwaterbedrijven:

  • Aansluiten bij werksessies en de reflectiekring: je ziet hoe bijeenkomsten met bestuurders, beleidsmakers en wetenschappers worden gestructureerd en werkt de uitkomsten uit tot heldere syntheses.

  • Analyseren en schrijven: je voert interviews uit, analyseert beleidsdocumenten en schrijft mee aan rapportages en publicaties.

  • Initiatief nemen: je werkt mee aan inhoudelijke kennissessies en netwerkevenementen om het watercluster van Berenschot op de kaart te zetten.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Je maakt deel uit van het team Duurzame Leefomgeving; een groep van 22 bevlogen adviseurs met specialisaties in ruimtelijke ordening, planologie en bestuurskunde. Dit team is onderdeel van de adviesgroep Energie en Leefomgeving, waarin zeventig adviseurs samenwerken aan diverse vraagstukken in de fysieke leefomgeving. Je werkt in wisselende projectteams om iedere opdracht optimaal te bemensen, waarbij we naast het inhoudelijke vraagstuk ook governance, organisatie-inrichting, veranderopgaven en regionale samenwerking meenemen in onze advisering.


Dit neem je mee

Je bent een nieuwsgierige en analytisch sterke student die maatschappelijke vraagstukken weet te verbinden met onderzoek en praktijk.

Daarnaast:

  • volg je een masteropleiding in de richting van planologie, watermanagement, omgevingswetenschappen of een vergelijkbare studie

  • heb je affiniteit met vraagstukken rondom water, klimaatadaptatie, ruimtelijke ordening of publieke samenwerking

  • beschik je over sterke analytische en communicatieve vaardigheden

  • werk je zelfstandig, maar zoek je actief de samenwerking op

  • beheers je de Nederlandse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk

Om stage te kunnen lopen bij Berenschot, moet je gedurende de gehele stageperiode ingeschreven staan bij een universitaire onderwijsinstelling. Studenten van Wageningen University & Research, Rijksuniversiteit Groningen, Universiteit van Amsterdam, TU Delft en Radboud Universiteit worden nadrukkelijk uitgenodigd om te reageren.

jobs.title: Senior Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Voor onze afdeling Controls Engineering in Gorinchem zijn we per direct op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Controls Engineer voor het programmeren van de aansturing van onze nieuwste voedselproductie lijnen voor onze klanten van het merk Tromp uit Gorinchem. Dit betreft een full time functie, met veel afwisseling en hulp van betrokken teamgenoten om de meest slimme/ efficiënte besturingsoplossingen te bouwen.

Ontwerp en programmeer jij graag de nieuwste deegverwerkingsmachines van AMF Bakery Systems? Step dan in als Senior Controls Engineer! Heb je ervaring als software, controls of mechatronica engineer in machinebouw, ben je vertrouwd met programmeren in structured text en ben je bekend met Siemens besturingstechniek? Hecht je aan betrokken en slimme collega's waarmee je samen 'state of the art' voedselproductielijnen ontwerpt, programmeert en bouwt? Super, dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Maandsalaris tussen €4.00,00 en €5.800,00 o.b.v. 40 uur; afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring, excl. toeslagen

  • Reiskostenvergoeding (€0,25 / km); vitaliteitsbudget tot €25,00 netto per maand en een zeer goede pensioenvoorziening (PME)

  • Flexibele werktijden, deels thuiswerken mogelijk

  • Vakantiegeld 8%

  • CAO Metalektro waaronder 27 vakantiedagen en 13 adv dagen per jaar

  • Winstdeling, afhankelijk van de winst betreffende het jaar, tot max. €2.000,00

  • Uitstekende opleidingsmogelijkheden zodat jouw vakkennis up to date is en blijft

  • Werken in een enthousiast en innoverend team

  • Informele werksfeer, teamuitjes, vrijdagmiddagborrel

  • Alle ruimte om te groeien in je functie afhankelijk van jouw ambities


Wat ga je doen:

  • Ontwikkelen / programmeren, configureren en integreren van software van onze machines (PLC + HMI). We passen veel techniek toe van Siemens en Allen Bradley.

  • Testen op locatie Gorinchem (IO, netwerk, drives, functioneel)

  • Softwarematig helpen met voorbereiden van productielijnen voor de FAT

  • Inzetten van jouw software expertise voor ondersteuning van Assembly, Buitendienst en aan klanten bij complexe software gerelateerde issues

  • Incidenteel naar de klant voor ondersteuning van commissioning van nieuwe productie lijnen

  • Als onze software expert werk je intensief samen met Electrical en Mechanical engineers, collega's van Sales, Projectmanagers, Assembly Engineers etc. Je bent dan vraagbaak en neemt besluiten mbt onze software oplossingen.

  • Bijdragen aan het continue verder verbeteren van onze technische controls oplossingen conform onze Markel Business aanpak

  • Helpen met verder standaardiseren van onze software oplossingen van onze product portfolio van het merk Tromp in Gorinchem.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig aan jouw projecten


  • HBO Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar, of ROC Mechatronica niv 4 met ruime ervaring

  • Gedegen kennis van en ervaring met Siemens Tia Portal en of Allen Bradley Studio 5000

  • Kennis van hogere programmeertalen (vb. Structured text of VBA)

  • Teamplayer, pragmatisch en leergierig

  • Communicatief vaardig (goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal)

Bij AMF Bakery Systems ben je onderdeel van een hechte en trotse groep collega’s die wereldwijd bijdraagt aan het succes van industriële bakkerijen. Wat ons verbindt, is onze drive om te innoveren én onze zorg voor de wereld om ons heen. Zo ontwikkelden wij samen de eerste industriële oven op waterstof – een grote stap richting een duurzamere toekomst.

We werken met ruim 220 collega’s in Nederland – vanuit Gorinchem, Amersfoort en Nieuwleusen – en maken deel uit van de internationale Markel Food Group. Binnen AMF voelt iedereen zich thuis: of je nu op kantoor werkt, in de werkplaats of bij de klant op locatie. We geloven dat we samen sterker zijn als iedereen zich welkom, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelt.

Diversiteit en inclusie zitten dan ook in ons DNA. We staan open voor mensen met verschillende achtergronden en ideeën, omdat we weten dat juist die mix leidt tot slimme oplossingen en sterke teams. Jij hoort erbij – precies zoals je bent.

Samen bouwen we aan iets groters dan alleen machines. We bouwen aan een toekomst waarin we samen kunnen groeien, leren en impact maken.

jobs.title: Solution Engineer
jobs.description:
À propos de Dastra

Dastra est une plateforme SaaS dédiée à la protection des données, à la conformité et à la gouvernance de l'IA.

Nous accompagnons des organisations de toutes tailles dans la structuration et le pilotage de leurs enjeux de conformité, avec une ambition : rendre des sujets complexes plus simples, accessibles et opérationnels.

Dans un contexte de croissance et de développement à l'international, nous renforçons notre organisation commerciale et recrutons notre PreSales Engineer pour accompagner nos opportunités stratégiques.

Ton rôle chez Dastra

À la croisée du business, de la technologie et du conseil, tu joueras un rôle clé dans nos cycles de vente complexes.

Ta mission : apporter la crédibilité et les preuves techniques qui feront de Dastra la solution de référence pour nos futurs clients.

En véritable partenaire de nos équipes Sales, tu interviendras sur les opportunités stratégiques pour comprendre les enjeux techniques des prospects, démontrer la pertinence de notre plateforme et sécuriser leur décision.

Tes missions

  • Qualifier les besoins techniques : conduire les phases de Technical Discovery, analyser les environnements IT des prospects et échanger avec leurs interlocuteurs techniques (DSI, RSSI, équipes IT), en complément de la qualification business réalisée par les Sales.

  • Démontrer la valeur de Dastra : concevoir des environnements de démonstration personnalisés, construire des cas d'usage pertinents et animer des démonstrations adaptées aux enjeux métiers et techniques des clients.

  • Piloter les Proof of Concept (POC) : définir les critères de succès, organiser les validations techniques et apporter les preuves concrètes de l'adéquation de notre solution aux besoins du client.

  • Sécuriser les cycles de vente complexes : répondre aux questions d'architecture, d'intégration, de sécurité et de configuration (SSO, API, interconnexions, MCP...) et lever les objections techniques des prospects.

  • Contribuer activement aux appels d'offres (RFP) : participer à l'élaboration des réponses fonctionnelles, à la définition des plans de déploiement et à la préparation des démonstrations, jusqu'aux soutenances auprès des clients.

  • Assurer la continuité entre avant-vente et déploiement : collaborer avec les équipes Sales, Produit, Customer Success et Professional Services pour cadrer les besoins et garantir une transmission technique structurée après signature.

Tu contribueras également à l'amélioration continue de nos pratiques avant-vente, de nos démonstrations et de notre documentation technique.

Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Tu disposes d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience en avant-vente technique, idéalement en tant que PreSales Engineer, Sales Engineer ou Solution Consultant, dans un environnement SaaS B2B.

  • Tu as l'habitude d'accompagner des cycles de vente complexes auprès de grands comptes, avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques exigeants.

  • Tu possèdes une solide compréhension des architectures SaaS, des intégrations, des problématiques de sécurité et des environnements IT.

  • Tu connais les enjeux de Privacy, conformité, GRC ou cybersécurité, et sais les traduire en solutions concrètes pour tes clients.

  • Tu combines expertise technique, sens commercial et excellente communication : tu sais vulgariser des sujets complexes, convaincre et adapter ton discours à tes interlocuteurs.

  • Tu fais preuve d'agilité intellectuelle, de pédagogie, de pragmatisme et de sang-froid, y compris lors de démonstrations en direct.

  • Tu maîtrises parfaitement le français et l'anglais (niveau C2) pour évoluer dans un environnement international.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Un rôle stratégique : intervenir directement sur les opportunités à fort potentiel et contribuer à la croissance de Dastra.

  • Un environnement stimulant : évoluer à l'intersection du SaaS, de la protection des données, de la cybersécurité et de l'intelligence artificielle.

  • Une fonction en construction : rejoindre une organisation avant-vente en cours de structuration, avec l'opportunité de contribuer à son développement.

  • Une collaboration transverse : travailler au quotidien avec les équipes Sales, Produit, Customer Success et Professional Services.

Conditions & avantages

  • 5 semaines de congés payés + 10 jours de RTT

jobs.title: Medior/Senior R&D Engineer Interoperability in Battle Labs & Experimentation (m/v/x/)

Ben jij een specialist op het gebied van computernetwerken en protocollen en heb je affiniteit met het toepassen van simulatie- en trainingssystemen in een R&D context? Wil jij werken in een innovatieve onderzoeksomgeving waar geavanceerde simulatoren en interoperabiliteit centraal staan? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen?

Als netwerk-expert binnen onze afdeling ben je verantwoordelijk voor onderzoek en ontwikkeling gericht op netwerken en systemen die verschillende simulatoren en operationele systemen veilig en efficiënt met elkaar verbinden. Je werkt aan vraagstukken met betrekking tot netwerkarchitecturen, (simulatie)protocollen zoals DIS en HLA, netwerkbeveiliging en schaalbaarheid van complexe simulatieomgevingen. Je levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan het mogelijk maken van interoperabiliteit tussen simulatoren, operationele systemen en autonome platforms, en bent betrokken bij de (door)ontwikkeling van zowel bestaande als nieuwe simulatienetwerken. In multidisciplinaire teams werk je samen met onder andere softwareontwikkelaars, domeinexperts en toekomstige eindgebruikers aan innovatieve oplossingen voor nationale en internationale stakeholders. Je bent hiervoor bereid om te reizen naar verschillende locaties, voornamelijk binnen Nederland.

Wat breng je mee?

Je bent iemand die in kansen denkt en nieuwsgierig is om bij te dragen aan oplossingen die werken in de praktijk. Je hebt heel makkelijk contact met eindgebruikers en kan hun wensen en ideeën snel in creatieve implementaties omzetten. Met je creatieve instelling maak je nieuwe technieken snel eigen en weet je deze te vertalen naar concrete resultaten!

Daarnaast:

  • Heb je een afgeronde bachelor of master opleiding in ICT, Computer Science, Informatica, Informatiekunde, of vergelijkbaar;

  • Heb je minstens 8 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan minstens 5 jaar ervaring op het gebied van netwerktechnologie, TCP/UDP, netwerkprotocollen, routering, switching en netwerkbeveiliging;

  • Beheers je meerdere programmeertalen zoals C, C++, C#, Java en ervaring in scripting om experimenteeromgevingen snel op te zetten of aan te passen;

  • Heb je interesse in experimenteren, wargaming en simulatie in een R&D-context;

  • Heb je ervaring met het ontwerpen en beheren van robuuste, schaalbare netwerkomgevingen;

  • Ben je bereid om je te verdiepen in (militaire) luchtvaartoperaties;

  • Werk je graag samen, durft je te experimenteren en kan je technische keuzes uitleggen aan niet-technische collega’s;

  • Kan jij je in de Nederlandse en Engelse taal zowel mondeling als schriftelijk uitstekend uitdrukken.

Nice to have:

  • Ervaring met of interesse in simulatie- en interoperabiliteitsprotocollen (DIS/HLA/FOMs);

  • Ervaring met het opzetten van tijdelijke of experimentele infrastructuren;

  • Kennis van netwerkbeveiliging of VPN-oplossingen;

  • Ervaring met monitoring- of observabilitytools;

  • Interesse in nieuwe technologieën zoals autonome systemen, AI in simulatie of digitale twins.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten.

Naast dit alles bieden wij jou:

  • De kans om bij te dragen aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken;

  • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer;

  • Een zorgtoelage via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • Een goede pensioenregeling

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Bij de afdeling Training & Simulatie werken op dit moment rond de 100 deskundigen op het gebied van simulatie, informatica, training, luchtvaart en psychologie. Binnen onze projecten wordt multidisciplinair samengewerkt, zowel binnen als buiten het NLR. De afdeling beschikt over allerlei onderzoeksfaciliteiten zoals een battlelab en simulatoren voor gevechtsvliegtuig- en onbemande systemen en een laboratorium dat zich richt op AR/VR innovaties. Een plezierige werkomgeving vinden we essentieel. De sfeer binnen de afdeling is informeel en collegiaal en we vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zich thuis kan voelen bij ons.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties.

Bij ons werken bijna 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt.
